fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on a $50,000 libel suit and arrest involving Justice of the Peace Penney and editor Wen R. Phillips; discussion of Dade County commissioners’ finances and county deposits in a Homestead bank; criticism of worsening transportation service in Miami and Miami Beach under Florida Power and Light; and a piece on anti-tipping. Reports on Dade County Medical Association actions regarding a physicians’ exchange and nurses’ registry (mentioning Adele Hampton), along with extensive coverage and promotion of boxing events and the Tunney–Dempsey fight via radio at Biscayne Fronton. Includes society-style gossip items, letters to the editor, and advertisements.
